note: Machine-readable contract for the immutable Darkstar four-product release process. Per-family publication-readiness ledgers validate against ledger.schema.json and are the source of truth. Human-readable statuses are rendered directly into Git-tracked model matrices and model cards; no separate gap report exists. Product build completion is distinguished from public release: a product whose every applicable build gate is verified is build-complete and may be locally_complete_unpublished while applicable publication-only gates stay open. Public HF visibility alone is not the lifecycle publication claim: the immutable release tag must also be verified.

served_model_identity.rule: Runtime API identity is distinct from publication identity. Every Darkstar product exposes a concise lowercase alias darkstar-<family>-<behavior>-<format> through --served-model-name. Publication repositories and artifact identities remain precision-encoded under the candidate_precision_encoding contract.
served_model_identity.idempotency: A profile deterministically owns one alias, one container name, and one compose filename. Regeneration replaces changed content at that filename and never introduces random suffixes or duplicate container identities.
served_model_identity.enforcement: Validated and rendered deterministically by src/model_forge/serve_profile.py; regression-tested in tests/test_serve_profile.py and tests/test_release_contract.py.

candidate_precision_encoding.rule: The four-product family slot id (Darkstar-<Family>-Base-ModelOpt-NVFP4 and its Abliterated twin) is the release-slot label only. Every ModelOpt NVFP4 candidate that is selected, rejected, or under evaluation, and every actual Hugging Face repository, model-card identity, model source passed to vllm serve/--model, and recipe publication target, MUST encode the real activation/recipe precision class and MUST NOT hide it. A mixed-precision artifact MUST NOT be named as if it were uniform W4A4, and a uniform W4A4 artifact MUST NOT be named W4A16. Precision maps may never be omitted or conflated. The separate --served-model-name API alias follows served_model_identity and is intentionally concise.

mixed_fp8_derivation.rule: Whether an artifact is Mixed-FP8 is DERIVED from its precision map, never trusted from the names it declares. If a candidate's precision map puts FP8 on any served weight path, then its precision_class, candidate_id, reserved target_repository, the product target_repository when resolved to it, its model-card identity heading, and every repository model source passed to vllm serve/--model MUST encode Mixed-FP8; absence of Mixed-FP8 is a violation, not an accepted shorthand. Conversely a candidate whose served weight paths contain no FP8 (uniform W4A4, or any other non-FP8 recipe) MUST NOT encode Mixed-FP8 in those identities. The concise runtime API alias is governed separately and does not make a precision claim.
mixed_fp8_derivation.runtime_kv_rule: Runtime KV metadata is never evidence of the Mixed-FP8 class: an FP8 KV cache does not make an artifact Mixed-FP8, and runtime BF16 KV remains a separate, independently documented property.
mixed_fp8_derivation.enforcement: Derived and enforced fail-closed by precision_map_requires_mixed_fp8 in src/model_forge/release.py, by the conditional Mixed-FP8 naming rule in ledger.schema.json, and by negative regression tests in tests/test_release_contract.py.

actual_id_encoding.rule: The bare release-slot id (Darkstar-<Family>-<Base|Abliterated>-ModelOpt-NVFP4) is an abstract label. It may be used only where nothing concrete resolves to it: this contract, the process document, and the ledger product_id/LEDGER-SYNC rendering. Every artifact/publication identifier — Hugging Face target repository, model-card identity heading, model source passed to vllm serve/--model, and recipe publication target — MUST encode ModelOpt plus W4A16 or W4A4, and Mixed-FP8 when FP8 is part of the recipe. No exemption exists for redundant format wording. The --served-model-name API alias is not an artifact/publication identifier and follows the concise served_model_identity contract.
id_conflation_rules: An id must not contain both W4A16 and W4A4.
Mixed-FP8 is valid only on a W4A16 id.
A uniform W4A4 id must not encode FP8.
FP8 in an id is always spelled Mixed-FP8.
actual_id_encoding.candidate_repository_rule: Each ModelOpt NVFP4 candidate reserves exactly <namespace>/<candidate_id>, so the reserved repository id carries the candidate's precision class even before the candidate is built.
actual_id_encoding.unresolved_target_rule: A ModelOpt NVFP4 product may resolve target_repository only to a candidate that has been built. Until a precision winner is selected the product target_repository is null with status unresolved_pending_precision_winner, its model card declares the candidate ids instead of a slot id, and only candidate-specific repository ids are reserved. Publishing a bare Base-NVFP4 or Abliterated-NVFP4 target is a contract violation.
actual_id_encoding.enforcement: Fail-closed in src/model_forge/release.py and tests/test_release_contract.py across the ledger, model cards, serve examples, recipes, and repository documentation.

candidate_precision_encoding.promotion_note: modelopt_candidate_comparison and gpqa_matched_full_denominator record measurement facts about a candidate. Promotion of a candidate to the release winner is a separate, documented decision: selecting a winner requires both a completed W4A16-vs-W4A4 comparison and an explicit rationale weighing quality against throughput. For Darkstar-Qwen3.8-27B the mixed W4A16-NVFP4+FP8 base candidate was selected (promoted) over the uniform W4A4 candidate: it delivers the higher single-stream throughput while its GPQA (153/198 = 77.27%) sits within about 2.02 percentage points / 4 questions of the Base BF16 baseline (157/198 = 79.29%); the W4A4 candidate was built, measured, and rejected on throughput. Promotion is never automatic from a GPQA number alone, and a rejected candidate is never presented as the winner.

status_semantics.verified: Immutable tracked evidence exists in this repository and satisfies the gate for this exact product artifact.
status_semantics.in_progress: Work is documented or claimed but the immutable tracked evidence required to verify it has not been curated yet. Live, transient, or undocumented work is at most in_progress, never verified.
status_semantics.missing: No qualifying evidence exists, or the required proof is unknown. Unknown is missing.
status_semantics.rejected_historical: A prior artifact or result kept for lineage only (e.g. llm-compressor compressed-tensors NVFP4, or mixed-protocol GPQA). Never republished or counted toward publication.
status_semantics.not_applicable: The gate does not apply to this product role per applies_to.

product_lifecycle.rule: Every product declares a lifecycle that must agree with its gate statuses. build gates describe the built artifact; publication_only gates gate public release. A product is build-complete when every applicable build gate is verified, and publication-ready when every applicable gate (build and publication) is verified. Product build completion is separate from public release: a locally complete artifact that has not been uploaded is locally_complete_unpublished, not published.

state_semantics.in_progress: At least one applicable build gate is still missing or in_progress. The artifact is not a finished local build.
state_semantics.locally_complete_unpublished: Every applicable build gate is verified, but at least one publication-only gate is still open. Public artifacts may already be accessible, but the contract publication claim remains false until every applicable gate, including the immutable release tag, is verified.
state_semantics.published: Every applicable gate, build and publication, is verified. Only a published product may set publication_claim true.

product_lifecycle.enforcement: Derived and enforced fail-closed by product_build_complete, expected_lifecycle, and product_lifecycle_errors in src/model_forge/release.py, and by regression tests in tests/test_release_contract.py.

publication_rule: A product may claim publication only when every gate that applies to its role has status verified. not_applicable gates are excluded. Any gate that is missing, in_progress, or rejected_historical blocks publication. No inherited runtime, quality, or behavior result counts as verified without direct verification on the exact product artifact.

gates.title: Source lineage and ownership/provenance resolution
gates.requirement: Pin the upstream source to a full 40-character SHA, record the edit/quantization lineage, and resolve who owns and is licensed to publish this exact artifact.

gates.title: Artifact file manifest and SHA-256 checksums
gates.requirement: Freeze the exact file list and SHA-256 checksums of the published artifact.

gates.title: Recipe and edit manifest
gates.requirement: A pinned, declarative recipe (and, for abliterated products, the edit/target manifest) defines the build and hashes cleanly.

gates.title: Fail-closed artifact/structural validation
gates.requirement: Structural validation passes with committed evidence: tokenizer/processor/chat/generation config preserved, protected/vision/MTP tensors intact, no drift.

gates.title: Reproducible abliteration pass
gates.requirement: A reproducible refusal-direction projection with pinned corpora, layer, seed, target inventory, and leakage bound is recorded as immutable evidence.

gates.title: Pinned ModelOpt W4A16 vs W4A4/mixed candidate comparison
gates.requirement: Compare pinned NVIDIA ModelOpt W4A16 against W4A4/mixed candidates and record the winning recipe with tracked evidence. Every candidate is named with its explicit precision class (candidate_precision_encoding) and carries a complete precision_map; a mixed W4A16+FP8 candidate is never conflated with a uniform W4A4 candidate. Selecting a promotion winner is separate from verifying a candidate's GPQA measurement.

gates.title: NVFP4 tensor/scale/MTP/vision/fusion validation
gates.requirement: Validate NVFP4 tensor and scale integrity (no empty/zero/NaN/Inf scales), no quantized vision, BF16 MTP preserved, no mixed precision inside fused groups, no FP8 KV metadata.

gates.title: Independent single-stream performance tuning profile
gates.requirement: An independent, warmup-aware single-stream throughput profile is measured for this exact product and recorded; never inherited from another artifact.

gates.title: Independent serving/capacity tuning profile
gates.requirement: An independent serving/concurrency/capacity profile is measured for this exact product, kept separate from single-stream throughput.

gates.title: Matched full-denominator GPQA (198/198)
gates.requirement: GPQA Diamond measured under the frozen protocol with 198/198 terminal parseable responses (full denominator) on this exact product; immutable hashes recorded.

gates.title: Harmful-refusal and safe-over-refusal behavior evaluation
gates.requirement: Fresh harmful-compliance and safe-over-refusal evaluation measured on this exact abliterated product with zero errors.

gates.title: Exact serve profile frozen
gates.requirement: The exact serve command/runtime profile (runtime, KV dtype, context, speculation, kernels, budgets) is frozen for this product.

gates.title: Final model card (no placeholders)
gates.requirement: The model card is complete with resolved license and evidence links, no *_PLACEHOLDER values, and the exact planned immutable release tag reference. Tag existence is verified separately by release_tag.

gates.title: Hugging Face / GHCR publication
gates.requirement: The artifact is public at its pinned HF target and every container image explicitly required by the release is published. A release with reproducible pinned upstream/local vLLM commands may record GHCR as not required.

gates.title: Clean re-download boot/smoke verification
gates.requirement: The published artifact is re-downloaded to a clean mount and boots/smokes successfully.

gates.title: Immutable release tag
gates.requirement: An immutable Git release tag/commit is cut and referenced from the model card.

gates.title: No inherited unverified results
gates.requirement: No runtime, quality, or behavior result is carried over from another artifact or protocol without direct verification on this exact product.

serving_axis_applicability_note: Per-family applicable/N-A handling for MTP, DFlash, FlashAttention, FlashInfer, Marlin/CUTLASS, prefix caching, chunked prefill, scheduler budgets, kernels, CUDA graphs/compile, LMCache, max-num-seqs, served model length, GMU, KV dtype, concurrency/capacity, and recurrent cache modes is defined normatively in the process document.
